description: Detect an abnormal number of registration-related requests originating from the same source within a limited time window.
requirements: Correlate events originating from the same source.
Evaluate the number of relevant events within a temporal window.
Generate an alert when the configured threshold is exceeded.
restrictions: Only use protocol attributes observable by MMT.
The generated output must conform to the MMT event-based property format.
expected_behavior: The property should trigger when the number of relevant registration events from the same source exceeds the configured threshold within the specified time window.
ambiguities: The numerical threshold that defines an abnormal number of registration-related requests is not specified.
The duration of the limited time window is not specified.
The task does not define how the same source should be represented using available protocol attributes.
